_comment: One entry per AWS account (the key is the environment name and also the template EnvName: lowercase, max 12 chars). 'stack' is 'agent' (Docker/ECS/API Gateway/ALB/CloudWatch, infra/container.yaml) or 'platform' (S3/SNS/EventBridge alerts, infra/platform.yaml). 'profile' is the AWS CLI profile for that account: the ONLY credentials mechanism (create it with scripts/set_lab_credentials.py). 'parameters' override template defaults. Deploy the platform first so the agent links to its buckets and topic; the agent also deploys alone.

lab-new.description: Agent account: Docker agent on ECS, API Gateway, ALB, CloudWatch

lab-existing.description: Platform account: S3 buckets, SNS topics, EventBridge-scheduled weather alerts. Put its 12-digit id in expected_account once you know it (a safety check).
